svg.aria-label: One house of four rooms along one wall, joined by a strip of instructions that runs through them all: 1843, Ada Lovelace writing Note G while punched cards feed the Analytical Engine; 1936, a tape machine stepping cell by cell while its rule lights up on the blackboard; 1969, minicomputers, a terminal printing a C program and a teletype; today, a team at a board of explorations and one decision, and a screen working on its own.
